annotations.text:
Constraints on all three (SPEC v4 → Design):

· posters are the only color
· type carries the personality
· the chat reads like messages
· no bordered cards
· no stat tiles
· no mono uppercase labels
· one accent, one job: Play

Every board uses real content — Jake's memory text, his logged rows, the tonight picks with real TMDB posters, and his own note on Heat.

A — Marquee

The memory is the headline. Instrument Serif + Instrument Sans, warm near-black, amber only on Play.

Reference: Cursor's changelog restraint, A24's title stack, Mubi.

Tradeoff: the tallest You page of the three — set this large, the profile alone fills a screen.

B — Lobby

The shelf does the work. Archivo + Source Serif 4, warm brown-black, gold only on Play.

Reference: Criterion's crop discipline, Arc's warmth, Letterboxd done better.

Tradeoff: posters are loud, so the writing has to fight for attention in the left column.

C — Terminal for cinephiles

The log is an instrument. Geist + JetBrains Mono, dense rows, amber only on Play.

Reference: Raycast's density, Geist, Linear's date gutter.

Tradeoff: density reads as competence to a film buff and as a spreadsheet to everyone else.
